gaps.item: Every score report fails to load: GET /api/session/{sid}/results returns 500
gaps.source: rebuild-v2.md 3.5.5 'Extend GET /api/session/{sid}/results'; reports.md SR1-SR25 (all payloads)
gaps.evidence: curl -H 'X-Learner: a:audres03' /api/session/veZbl4hMyYU-i49dDbVTvw/results -> 500. Log: api_account.py:100 saved_diagnostic_results -> AttributeError: module 'server.api_results' has no attribute 'results'. app.py ROUTERS registers api_account before api_results, so its /api/session/{sid}/results route shadows S6's. The page then shows 'Couldn't load this report.' (I audited everything else on a scratch copy with that one line changed to api_results.report(sid, x_learner))
gaps.build: In api_account.saved_diagnostic_results, call api_results.report(sid, x_learner) (or move the passkey-diagnostic case into api_results and delete the duplicate route). Add a test_flow check that a finished mock's results return 200.

gaps.item: Sittings list is served by api_practice's old /api/history, not S6's: no chips, numbers, deltas, durations, open counts, rings, reviewed, notes, In progress, filters or counts
gaps.source: rebuild-v2.md 2.9 Sittings and 3.5.5 'Extend GET /api/history'; reports.md SR23, SR6, SR14, SR18
gaps.evidence: /api/history returns only {sessions:[{id,kind,started,finished,right,asked,estimate,topics,label}]}, with no counts/in_progress/weeks and no seq/modules/delta/ms/open/recovery/reviewed/note. api_practice.py:401 is registered before api_results.py:909. On /results/ the first card reads 'Today | Module | 510–710 | Review | Fix · 6': 0 .sc-chip, no '#1', no delta or minutes. A live mock (acQL3...) has no In progress group. ?kind=, limit, offset, sort=points_open, reviewed=, topic= and share= are ignored
gaps.build: Remove api_practice's GET /api/history (or have it return api_results.history). Check that /api/history?kind=mock&limit=1 has modules[].wrong/blank, counts and in_progress, and that the Tests/Today consumers still get 'sessions'.

gaps.item: Every Fix action is refused: POST /api/drill rejects source 'fix'
gaps.source: reports.md SR2 (Fix primary, body source:'fix'), §3.2 §2.6 'source adds fix'; rebuild-v2.md 1.2, 1.11, 2.8, 2.9
gaps.evidence: Clicking 'Win back ≈ 160 pts · 13 questions · 22 min' sends POST /drill {from_session, only:[...], source:'fix', order:'given'} -> 422 'choose from builder, challenge, ...', and the toast says 'Couldn't start that set. Try again.' The same 422 comes from the sitting card's 'Fix · 6' ({from_session, source:'fix'}) and from 'Fix all open · 47' ({mistakes:true, source:'fix'}). drill.SOURCES has no 'fix'. fixBody() adds source:'fix' to every report drill: the menu items, the mistake-row Fix, Fix this domain, Best value's Fix these n, Practise these n (blanks), the selection bar, the recovery strip's Fix, Up next's 'Start: <topic>' and the peek's Fix
gaps.build: Add 'fix' to drill.SOURCES (§2.6) and keep order:'given'. Add a check that the report's Fix primary body returns 200 with the qids in the order given.

gaps.item: Answer changes are never shown, though the runner records them
gaps.source: rebuild-v2.md 1.4 Changed tile, 1.10, 1.12 Changed filter/column, 1.13 'Changed B → D' tag; reports.md SR9 panel 3 and the instinct line
gaps.evidence: The seeded mock's qstate has m1q10 {changes:1, first:1} and m1q13 {changes:1, first:'99'}, but results.summary.changed = {total:0,...}. report() and core() read st['trail'], which the S5 runner never writes (it writes changes/first). So there is no Changed tile, no Show 'Changed' chip, no Judgement 'Answer changes' panel or instinct line, no ↺ table column and no 'Changed' player tag. judgement.instinct.changes=2 proves the data exists
gaps.build: Compute summary.changed and each review item's changes from qstate[qid].first plus the final answer (or have the runner append a trail through /state per R7), and keep the right→wrong / wrong→right / wrong→wrong buckets.

gaps.item: Sure and wrong / Guessed right never match any question
gaps.source: reports.md SR9 (Confidence panel, 'Sure and wrong' first Mistakes group, without_guesses), SR2 Fix menu items
gaps.evidence: results.judgement.sure_wrong = [77, 99] and guessed_right = [78, 98, 103] are attempt row ids (progress.py:1509), while the page compares them with review ids ('m1q04'). With 2 sure-wrong answers the report shows no 'Sure and wrong' group, no 'Sure and wrong · 2 … Fix these 2' line, no 'Guessed right' line and no menu or Act-on chips for either. judgement also has no without_guesses
gaps.build: Return question ids (qid) in sure_wrong/guessed_right for session calls, and add without_guesses = estimate.rescore(sid, wrong=guessed_right).

gaps.item: Selection bar crashes; no multi-question actions
gaps.source: reports.md SR15 Selection (Shift/Ctrl-click, Space, long-press; 'n selected · Fix these n · Twins · Print a retry sheet · Save n · What if…')
gaps.evidence: Cmd-click then Shift-click on grid cells throws PAGEERROR '(o.actions || []) is not iterable' 3 times, and no bar appears. page.js drawSel passes actions as a function (k => [...]), but kit.js selbar spreads o.actions as an array. Only Fix and What if are defined; Twins, Print retry sheet, Save, Space-to-toggle and phone long-press are absent
gaps.build: Pass an array to UI.selbar and rebuild the labels on update, and add Twins of these n, Print a retry sheet, Save n and What if these were right (+x). Add Space to toggle the focused cell and a long-press select mode on touch.

gaps.item: 'Add your R&W score' Save is refused
gaps.source: reports.md SR4 (inline R&W field, PUT /api/me {rw_now} plus a dated outside_scores row)
gaps.evidence: totalBlock sends PUT /api/me {rw_now, rw_source}. With that body the server returns 422 extra_forbidden loc body.rw_source (the Me model forbids extra fields), so the student gets 'Not saved. Try again.' No outside_scores row with math null is ever added
gaps.build: Send {rw_now} only, then add the dated history row through S3's add_outside_score({rw, math:null, source}) endpoint. Refresh the page so the Total line shows.

gaps.item: 'Stop sharing' leaves the progress link working
gaps.source: rebuild-v2.md 2.1 Share my progress ('Stop sharing'); R18(a)
gaps.evidence: The sheet sends POST /share {on:true}, then 'Stop sharing' sends POST /share {on:false}: both return 200, because api_profile.create_share ignores the body and mints a new token. The toast says 'Link turned off', but GET /api/stats?share=<old token> still returns 200
gaps.build: Call DELETE /api/share/{token} for Stop sharing, reuse an existing token (GET /api/share) instead of minting one on every open, and check that the old link then returns 404.

gaps.item: Shared progress view (/results/?share=) shows the viewer's own empty data
gaps.source: rebuild-v2.md 2.1 and 2.10 Shared view; 3.5.5 'Share progress: /api/stats, /api/history, /api/map and /api/skill accept ?share='
gaps.evidence: curl /api/history?share=TOKEN and /api/map?share=TOKEN -> 400 'send your learner token'. In a fresh browser the page's device token is used instead, so the shared view shows the sharer's estimate but 'Your first test puts a point here' in the chart, no sittings, and the viewer's blank skills. Card 'Open' links add &share=, which the results endpoint ignores (403)
gaps.build: Make /api/history (S6's route, once the shadow is removed) and /api/map accept ?share= through share_learner (GET only, no in_progress). Hide the per-question Open link in shared cards.

gaps.evidence: print emulation: .rp-ptable visible with 7 th: #, Skill, Your answer, Correct, Result, Mistake, Time. It has no Cause or Worth and no second table

gaps.item: Compare: empty skills table and no side-by-side pair player
gaps.source: reports.md SR7 (skills [{topic, then, now}] with ▲▼; clicking a pair opens UI.review mode 'pair' with both bodies)
gaps.evidence: api_results.compare returns 'skills': [] (hard-coded). drawCompare's strip onPick opens the normal player on the now question only

gaps.item: In-site percentile: no 'needs 20' line and no dot histogram
gaps.source: rebuild-v2.md 1.3 ('A percentile needs 20 first sections; 8 so far'); reports.md SR5 (rank.hist + UI.dotStrip at n≥20)
gaps.evidence: Mock #1 has rank {ranked:true, pct:null, n:2, why:'too few sittings'}, and the hero prints nothing about it. estimate.percentile returns no hist, and the page never calls UI.dotStrip
gaps.build: Print 'A percentile needs 20 first sections; n so far' when pct is null on a ranked sitting. Serve rank.hist (20-point bins, NOT_SAMPLE) and draw UI.dotStrip at n≥20.

gaps.item: Recovered count differs between hero and tile
gaps.source: decision 7 (one number per idea); reports.md SR6 ('Recovered 9 of 13')
gaps.evidence: Mock #1: the hero reads 'Recovered 6 of 9 · ≈ 85 since · 3 open', and the tile reads 'RECOVERED 6 of 13 ≈ 85 since'. The hero uses recovered+open+slipping; the tile uses all misses
gaps.build: Use one denominator (all misses in the sitting) in both places and one 'open' count.

gaps.item: Ledger bar prints every bucket twice
gaps.source: decision 7 (never repeat a fact on the same screen)
gaps.evidence: #ledger shows 'Traps ≈ 65 pts (6) · Clock ≈ 50 pts (4) · Gaps ≈ 35 pts (2)' on the bar segments and again in the legend row beneath, with the same numbers (seen at 1280)
gaps.build: In UI.stackBar, keep the numbers on the segments and show the legend only as swatches plus labels (or the list only on phones, where the segments carry no text).
